# 刻 — carve; time

**Strokes:** 8 · **Key (radical):** 刀 (as 刂, no. 18) · **JLPT:** N3 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

刻 has a cutting family and a time family. 刻む きざむ can mean chopping finely or engraving;
時刻 じこく means a time, especially a point on the clock.
In [遅刻](../words/遅刻.md) ちこく, the concern is arriving late.

**Modern-shape mnemonic:** imagine 刂 cutting small marks beside the slanting strokes on the left.
Use those marks to recall both carving and time markings, without treating the scene as historical evidence.

## Readings

Metadata also retains the source form きざ.み.

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| コク | on | [遅刻](../words/遅刻.md) ちこく — lateness; 時刻 じこく — time |
| きざ.む | kun | 刻む きざむ — chop finely; engrave |

## Common words

- [遅刻](../words/遅刻.md) ちこく — lateness; arriving late
- 時刻 じこく — time; clock time
- 刻む きざむ — chop finely; engrave

## Notes

Time and engraving are separate meanings to recognize in context; 遅刻 does not mean "slow carving."
時刻 can specify a clock time, while [時間](../words/時間.md) じかん also covers an amount of time.
[列](列.md), [到](到.md), and [判](判.md) have the same right-hand 刂 but different left sides.

# 効 — efficacy; effectiveness

**Strokes:** 8 · **Key (radical):** 力 (no. 19) · **JLPT:** N2 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

効 concerns effectiveness or an effect. 効く きく means to work effectively or take effect, while 効果 こうか names an effect. 有効 ゆうこう can mean effective or valid, depending on the thing being described.

**Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology:** Picture the crossing 交 shape beside 力, strength, as though effort is producing an effective result.

The canonical radical 力 is the right-hand component.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| コウ | on | [効果](../words/効果.md) こうか - effect; effectiveness |
| き.く | kun | [効く](../words/効く.md) きく - take effect; be effective |
| ききめ | kun | Source-only reading; see the qualification below. |
| なら.う | kun | Source-only reading; see the qualification below. |

KANJIDIC2 also records `ききめ`, `なら.う`. No suitable word example was established in the inspected JMdict snapshot. These are character-dictionary readings for lookup, not recommendations to use this kanji as an everyday spelling of a word.

## Common words

- [効く](../words/効く.md) きく - take effect; be effective
- [効果](../words/効果.md) こうか - effect; effectiveness
- [効力](../words/効力.md) こうりょく - efficacy; validity; potency
- [有効](../words/有効.md) ゆうこう - effective; valid

## Notes

- 効く is intransitive: 薬が効く くすりがきく means a medicine works. Its shared dictionary entry also includes 利く in expressions about faculties or senses; spelling choices belong to whole expressions.
- The ordinary word 効き目 ききめ means effectiveness. Its written き and separate 目 do not establish that 効 alone normally spells the whole reading ききめ. The source-only ききめ and ならう rows are retained for character-dictionary lookup.

Metadata: [KANJIDIC2](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/KANJIDIC_Project), 2026-10-21 snapshot. Word pairs: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entries 1275130, 1275250, 1541290, 1591070, 1591100.

# 努 — make an effort

**Strokes:** 7 · **Key (radical):** 力 (no. 19) · **JLPT:** N3 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

努 points to deliberate effort toward a goal. [努力](../words/努力.md) どりょく names that effort;
it does not itself say that the person succeeded.

**Modern-shape mnemonic:** use the 力 at the bottom as the effort holding up the 女-and-又 shapes.
This is a modern visual cue, not an explanation of the character's origin.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ド | on | [努力](../words/努力.md) どりょく — effort |
| つと.める | kun | 努める つとめる — strive; make an effort |

## Common words

- [努力](../words/努力.md) どりょく — effort; striving
- 努める つとめる — endeavor; try hard

## Notes

努める, [勤める](../words/勤める.md), and 務める all read つとめる.
Their useful learning contrast is effort, employment, and carrying out a role.
[勉](勉.md) also expresses effort or exertion, so it is close in meaning to 努.

Sources: [KANJIDIC2](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/KANJIDIC_Project);
[JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entries 1445130, 1240820, 1240825, 2872052.

# 責 — blame; hold responsible

**Strokes:** 11 · **Key (radical):** 貝 (no. 154) · **JLPT:** N3 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

責 connects blame with being answerable for something. 責める せめる is to blame or reproach,
whereas [責任](../words/責任.md) せきにん is responsibility or duty.
Having responsibility does not itself mean that someone has done something wrong.

**Modern-shape mnemonic:** imagine an account that must be answered for, with ruled bars over the 貝-shaped ledger.
This is a modern memory picture, not an etymology.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| セキ | on | 責任 せきにん — responsibility |
| せ.める | kun | 責める せめる — blame; reproach |

## Common words

- [責任](../words/責任.md) せきにん — responsibility; duty
- 責める せめる — blame someone

## Notes

In 人を責める (ひとをせめる), "blame someone," を marks the person blamed.
The top resembles [青](青.md), but the bottom is 貝, not 青's lower part.
[買](買.md) and [賛](賛.md) also have 貝 underneath; neither means assigning blame.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entries 1383180, 1383160.

# 詰 — pack tightly; press

**Strokes:** 13 · **Key (radical):** 言 (no. 149) · **JLPT:** N2 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

詰 concerns packing or pressing things together and reaching a tight or final point. Its extensions include close questioning and being checkmated; they are not all literal acts of filling a container.

**Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology:** See 言 on the left and the compact 吉-shaped right side, with 士 stacked tightly over 口. Imagine words squeezed into a small space; this is a mnemonic, not etymology.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| キツ | on | 詰問 きつもん - close questioning; demanding an explanation |
| キチ | on | Source-only reading; see the qualification below. |
| つ.める | kun | [詰める](../words/詰める.md) つめる - pack; fill |
| つ.め | kun | 詰め つめ - packing; final stage; endgame |
| -づ.め | kun | [缶詰め](../words/缶詰.md) かんづめ - canned food; [瓶詰](../words/瓶詰.md) びんづめ - bottling; bottled; -づめ means packed in |
| つ.まる | kun | [詰まる](../words/詰まる.md) つまる - be packed; be blocked |
| つ.む | kun | 詰む つむ - be checkmated |

KANJIDIC2 also records キチ. A full scan of the pinned JMdict snapshot found no entry combining a spelling containing 詰 with a reading containing きち, so no suitable example was established here. This bounded negative check does not prove that no such word exists elsewhere. Contracted きっ in another word would not, by itself, distinguish underlying キチ from キツ. Keep キチ as character-dictionary lookup information, not as a recommended pronunciation of the examples above.

## Common words

- [詰める](../words/詰める.md) つめる - pack; fill
- [詰まる](../words/詰まる.md) つまる - be packed; be clogged
- 詰問 きつもん - close questioning; demanding an explanation
- [缶詰め](../words/缶詰.md) かんづめ - canned food
- [瓶詰](../words/瓶詰.md) びんづめ - bottling; bottled

## Notes

- Learn the whole verbs: 詰める is ichidan; 詰まる and 詰む are intransitive godan verbs in the senses shown. 詰む つむ is not the same verb as 詰める つめる.
- The noun 詰め つめ and suffix -づめ are separate uses. The suffix can follow a noun, as in 缶詰め; its dictionary entry also covers continuous action after a verb's -ます stem. It is not an independent noun pronounced づめ.
- 詰む also has a colloquial extension for being hard-pressed or out of options. The checkmate example does not make all uses of this verb colloquial.

Metadata: [KANJIDIC2](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/KANJIDIC_Project), 2026-10-21 snapshot. Word pairs: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entries 1214560, 1226480, 1226490, 1226500, 1226510, 1226570, 1491130, 2861276.

# 査 — investigate; inspect

**Strokes:** 9 · **Key (radical):** 木 (no. 75) · **JLPT:** N2 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

査 concerns examining or investigating something. 検査 けんさ can be an inspection or test, while 調査 ちょうさ is an investigation or survey. Learn the complete words rather than using サ as an independent verb.

**Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology:** Notice 木 above the 且-like lower form and imagine examining a wooden object resting on a stand. This is a modern-shape memory aid, not an account of the character's origin.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| サ | on | [検査](../words/検査.md) けんさ - inspection; examination; [巡査](../words/巡査.md) じゅんさ - police officer; constable |

## Common words

- [検査](../words/検査.md) けんさ - inspection; examination
- [調査](../words/調査.md) ちょうさ - investigation; survey
- [巡査](../words/巡査.md) じゅんさ - police officer; constable

## Notes

- The 検査 article explains testing or checking against a standard; 調査 emphasizes gathering information. Their uses can overlap, so this is not an exclusive division of every investigation.
- Distinguish the lower 且-like shape from 日 in [昔](昔.md) or [昼](昼.md). This is a written-form comparison, not evidence of a shared pronunciation.

Metadata: [KANJIDIC2](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/KANJIDIC_Project), 2026-10-21 snapshot. Word pairs: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entries 1257890, 1342110, 1429120.

# 調 — investigate; tune

**Strokes:** 15 · **Key (radical):** 言 (no. 149) · **JLPT:** N3 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

調 has an investigation side in [調べる](../words/調べる.md) しらべる and a tone or condition side
in 調子 ちょうし. Learn the reading with the word: looking up a fact is not the same action
as tuning an instrument, even though the character connects this vocabulary.

**Modern-shape mnemonic:** 言 beside the enclosing 周 shape can suggest asking carefully
about what is inside an area. This is an invented memory scene, not a historical explanation.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| しら.べる | kun | [調べる](../words/調べる.md) しらべる — investigate; look up |
| チョウ | on | 調子 ちょうし — tone; condition |

## Common words

- [調べる](../words/調べる.md) しらべる — examine; check; look up
- 調子 ちょうし — tone; condition; state of health

## Notes

調子がいい (ちょうしがいい) can mean "in good condition"; the subject determines
whether you are discussing a person or something else.
[週](週.md) also contains 周 but has the movement-shaped outer part.
[語](語.md) and [訪](訪.md) instead share 言.

Metadata: [KANJIDIC2](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/KANJIDIC_Project).

Vocabulary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entries 1429060, 1429170.

# 究 — investigate thoroughly

**Strokes:** 7 · **Key (radical):** 穴 (no. 116) · **JLPT:** N4 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

究 concerns research and pursuing a subject deeply. It is especially useful in
[研究](../words/研究.md) (けんきゅう, research).

**Modern-shape mnemonic, not verified etymology:** under the cave-like 穴 top sits [九](九.md), "nine."
Imagine nine questions to investigate inside a cave. This is a memory aid, not a claim that 九 supplies the sound.

## Readings

Selected readings are shown; metadata also retains ク.

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| キュウ | on | [研究](../words/研究.md) けんきゅう — research; 究明 きゅうめい — investigation |
| きわ.める | kun | 究める きわめる — investigate thoroughly; master |

## Common words

- [研究](../words/研究.md) けんきゅう — research
- 研究者 けんきゅうしゃ — researcher
- 究明 きゅうめい — investigation to establish the facts

## Notes

[研](研.md) and 究 work together in 研究: both contribute an idea of studying closely.
究める is useful for recognition, but 研究する is the more immediately useful research expression for this card.

[空](空.md) shares the 穴 top. Check the bottom: 究 has 九; 空 has 工.

# 罪 — crime; guilt

**Strokes:** 13 · **Key (radical):** 网 (as 罒, no. 122) · **JLPT:** N3 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

罪 concerns wrongdoing and the guilt attached to it. The word [罪](../words/罪.md) つみ
can refer to a crime or to a sin; the surrounding discussion determines whether the judgment
is legal, moral, or religious.

**Modern-shape mnemonic:** imagine the top 罒 as a net hanging over the 非 shape while
wrongdoing is examined. This is a memory scene, not a historical account.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| つみ | kun | [罪](../words/罪.md) つみ — crime; sin |
| ザイ | on | 犯罪 はんざい — crime; 有罪 ゆうざい — guilt |

## Common words

- [罪](../words/罪.md) つみ — wrongdoing; crime; sin
- 犯罪 はんざい — crime; offense
- 有罪 ゆうざい — guilt; being guilty
- 無罪 むざい — innocence; being not guilty

## Notes

The indexing radical is 网, visibly written 罒 here; it is not the eye radical 目.
[置](置.md) and [買](買.md) share that top. [四](四.md) is a simpler outline comparison.
Not every 間違い (まちがい), "mistake," amounts to a 罪.

# 処 — deal with; dispose

**Strokes:** 5 · **Key (radical):** 几 (no. 16) · **JLPT:** N3 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

In [処理](../words/処理.md) しょり, 処 contributes dealing with or handling something.
Other useful compounds concern responding to a situation or disposing of something.
The character also has place-related senses, but "place" does not explain 処理.

**Modern-shape mnemonic:** imagine the sweeping left part clearing things past the little 几-shaped
stand on the right. This is a visual cue for "deal with," not a claim about historical components.

## Readings

The table focuses on ショ in compounds. The source's kun readings remain in the metadata.

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ショ | on | [処理](../words/処理.md) しょり — processing; 対処 たいしょ — dealing with |

## Common words

- [処理](../words/処理.md) しょり — processing; handling
- 対処 たいしょ — dealing with; coping with
- 処分 しょぶん — disposal; also punishment, depending on context

## Notes

処理 is not automatically "throwing away": data can be processed without being discarded.
The right-hand outline distinguishes 処 from [外](外.md); [冬](冬.md) has two dots underneath instead.
[風](風.md) offers a looser comparison through its enclosing hooked outline.

# 偵 — spy; covert investigation

**Strokes:** 11 · **Key (radical):** 人 (as 亻, no. 9) · **JLPT:** N1 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

偵 concerns finding out hidden information, as in spying or covert investigation.
[探偵](../words/探偵.md) たんてい names a detective or investigator;
it does not automatically mean an enemy agent.
Learn 偵 through compounds rather than treating it as a standalone word for a detective.

The visible parts are 亻, the side form of [人](人.md), and 貞.
**Modern-shape mnemonic:** picture a person on the left keeping watch beside
the tall, boxed shape on the right. This is a visual memory aid, not an
etymology or an explanation based on 貞's meaning.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| テイ | on | [探偵](../words/探偵.md) たんてい — detective; investigator |

No kun reading is supplied in the frozen character metadata.
In 探偵, 探 supplies タン and 偵 supplies テイ.

## Common words

- [探偵](../words/探偵.md) たんてい — detective; investigator
- 探偵小説 たんていしょうせつ — detective story
- 偵察 ていさつ — scouting; reconnaissance

## Notes

- A 探偵 may be a private investigator; [刑事](../words/刑事.md) けいじ
  specifically names a police detective in its person sense.
  The shared English word "detective" does not make these identical job labels.
- [停](停.md), "halt; stopping," shares 亻 and テイ but has a different
  right side, with a roof-like top and a long lower hook.
- [低](低.md), "low," and [値](値.md), "value; price," also share 亻.
  Compare the entire right side, not just the radical or a boxed outline.

Metadata: [KANJIDIC2](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/KANJIDIC_Project).
Word pairs: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project),
entries 1418380, 1418390, 1435100 and 1249660.
Character meaning and reading: [Jitsu, 偵](https://kotobank.jp/word/偵-573318).

# 力 — power

**Strokes:** 2 · **Key (radical):** 力 (no. 19) · **JLPT:** N4 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

力 is commonly explained as a pictograph of a bent arm showing muscle, which gives "strength"; another explanation sees an old plough-like digging tool.
The origin is debated. It means "power, strength, effort, force".
As a key it appears in characters about effort and work: 助 (help), 動 (move), 働 (work). 男 ([男](男.md), man, 田 field + 力) contains 力 as a component, but its key is 田.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| リョク | on | 体力 たいりょく, 努力 どりょく, 能力 のうりょく, 電力 でんりょく, 協力 きょうりょく |
| リキ | on | 力士 りきし, 自力 じりき, 馬力 ばりき |
| リイ | on | rare, not needed at this level |
| ちから | kun | [力](../words/力.md) ちから, 力持ち ちからもち, 力強い ちからづよい |

## Common words

- [力](../words/力.md) ちから — strength, power
- 体力 たいりょく — physical strength
- 努力 どりょく — effort
- 力士 りきし — sumo wrestler

## Notes

リョク is the main on reading in compounds; リキ appears in a few older ones. The kun reading ちから can voice inside compounds: 力強い ちからづよい, 底力 そこぢから.

Look-alike: 刀 (sword) has the same two strokes in the same order; in 力 the left-falling stroke crosses the horizontal one, while in 刀 it starts on it.

# 亥 — Boar zodiac sign

**Strokes:** 6 · **Key (radical):** 亠 (no. 8), at the top · **JLPT:** N1 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

亥 names the **twelfth zodiac sign**, the Boar, in the twelve-sign cycle.
The native sign noun is [亥](../words/亥.md) い. It is not the ordinary
name for a living wild boar, [猪](../words/猪.md) いのしし, or a domestic
pig, [豚](../words/豚.md) ぶた.

**Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology:** picture a zodiac label beneath
the two-stroke 亠 cap, with slanting strokes spreading below it.
This is a drawing memory aid, not a historical account of the character.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ガイ | on | 辛亥 しんがい — the Metal Boar, the 48th term of the sixty-term calendar cycle; recognition only |
| カイ | on | KANJIDIC2 source-only reading; no verified word example established for this lesson; not selected for practice |
| い | kun | [亥](../words/亥.md) い — Boar zodiac sign; 亥年 いどし — year of the Boar |

Only い is selected for practice. ガイ is independently documented in
calendar compounds; this does not make it the reading of the standalone
native noun. カイ remains in the full source list: the lack of a corroborated
example here does not establish that it is invalid or restricted to names.

## Common words

- [亥](../words/亥.md) い — Boar zodiac sign
- 亥年 いどし — year of the Boar

## Notes

- [刻](刻.md), carve/time, has a similar left shape plus 刂.
  [交](交.md), intersect/mingle, and [亡](亡.md), deceased, share the
  亠 top but have different lower strokes. None names the Boar sign.
- In historical texts, 亥 can also identify an hour around 10 p.m.,
  a direction approximately north-northwest, or the tenth lunar month.
  These are not ordinary modern scheduling terms. The hour has differing
  dictionary mappings, including 9–11 p.m. and 10 p.m.–midnight;
  lunar month ten is not simply October.
- The twelve signs and the sixty combinations of calendar stems and
  branches are related systems, not identical lists.
- The source's grade-9 tag classifies name-use kanji; it does not make
  the sign noun a name-only word. Historical kana ゐ does not add another
  modern reading.

# 批判 (ひはん) - criticism; critical judgment

## Meaning

批判 is a noun for criticism or critical judgment. 批判する
is transitive, with the person, policy, or action criticized marked
by を. As a noun, Nへの批判 identifies criticism directed
toward N.

- 住民は市の計画を批判しました。 (じゅうみんはしのけいかくをひはんしました。) - The residents criticized the city's plan.
- その発言は多くの批判を受けました。 (そのはつげんはおおくのひはんをうけました。) - That statement received a great deal of criticism.

批判を受ける names receiving criticism, whereas 批判する
names giving it. Keep that difference in perspective clear.

## How the kanji combine

批 contributes criticism or evaluation, and [判](../kanji/判.md)
contributes judgment. The related ideas combine into critical
assessment. Their on readings are ひ + はん.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[批評](批評.md) (ひひょう) also concerns critical appraisal,
for example of a work. [意見](意見.md) (いけん) is the
broader word "opinion"; an opinion need not criticize anything.
Praise is a contextual opposite, but criticism can also include
reasoned evaluation rather than simple personal hostility.

## Distinctive meaning

批判 is not a neutral substitute for every English "comment."
It frames the statement as criticism or judgment, often drawing
attention to problems. Nor does the word itself establish whether
the criticism is fair, well supported, or constructive; those are
separate evaluations of its content.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1483420, sense 1.

# 批評 (ひひょう) - critique; review

## Meaning

批評 is a noun for a critique, review, or evaluative commentary. With する, it becomes a transitive verb: **Nを批評する**, "critique or review N."

- 新しい映画の批評を読みました。 (あたらしいえいがのひひょうをよみました。) - I read a review of the new film.
- 授業で互いの作品を批評しました。 (じゅぎょうでたがいのさくひんをひひょうしました。) - In class, we critiqued one another's work.

In 映画の批評, の identifies the subject of the review. In the second example, を marks the work being evaluated.

## How the kanji combine

批 contributes critical examination, and 評 contributes appraisal or comment. Their related meanings combine into evaluating and commenting on something. The reading is ひ + ひょう; keep the long vowel in ひょう.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[批判](批判.md) (ひはん) also involves critical judgment and can overlap. 批評 is useful for examining a work's qualities, not simply declaring dislike. [意見](意見.md) (いけん), "opinion," is broader and need not amount to a review.

## Distinctive meaning

A 批評 can identify strengths as well as weaknesses. Do not assume the English translation "criticism" means an insult or exclusively negative remarks. Nor is 批評 the same as retelling the plot: the evaluative viewpoint is important, whether the overall judgment is favorable or unfavorable.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1483440.

# 評論 (ひょうろん) - critique; critical essay

## Meaning

評論 is critical discussion or evaluation of a work, issue, or other
subject, and also a text expressing that discussion.
It is a noun and a transitive する verb: Nを評論する,
critique or discuss N critically.

- 新聞で映画の評論を読みました。 (しんぶんでえいがのひょうろんをよみました。) - I read a critique of a film in the newspaper.
- この本には文学の評論が収められています。 (このほんにはぶんがくのひょうろんがおさめられています。) - This book contains literary criticism.

評論家 (ひょうろんか) names a critic or commentator.

## How the kanji combine

評 contributes appraisal or comment, and [論](../kanji/論.md)
discussion or argument. The related meanings combine in discussing
and assessing a subject. The on readings are ヒョウ + ロン.
The word is not simply any text containing an opinion.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[批評](批評.md) (ひひょう) also means a critique or review.
[批判](批判.md) (ひはん) overlaps in critical judgment, while
[評価](評価.md) (ひょうか) concerns assessment or appraisal.
Their uses overlap; do not invent an absolute rule assigning every
film review, political comment, or literary essay to only one term.

## Distinctive meaning

"Critical" here means examining and assessing, not necessarily
attacking someone or giving an unfavorable verdict.
評論 can discuss strengths as well as weaknesses.
A mere plot summary or a personal reaction is not automatically
a developed critical discussion.

entry 1490080, sense 1.

# 責める (せめる) - to blame; reproach

## Meaning

責める is a transitive ichidan verb meaning "blame," "reproach," or "criticize."
The person blamed takes を. A phrase with ことで can explain what they are blamed for.

- 失敗したことで彼を責めないでください。 (しっぱいしたことでかれをせめないでください。) - Please do not blame him for failing.
- 彼女は自分を責めていました。 (かのじょはじぶんをせめていました。) - She was blaming herself.

Useful forms include 責めます, 責めた, and 責めない.
In the passive, 彼に責められた (かれにせめられた) means "I was blamed by him";
に identifies the person doing the blaming.

## How the kanji combine

[責](../kanji/責.md) carries the association of blame or responsibility.
The native verb reads せめる, with める written as okurigana.
Compare [責任](責任.md) (せきにん), "responsibility," which uses the on reading セキ.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[叱る](叱る.md) (しかる), "scold," emphasizes a reprimand; 責める emphasizes holding someone
at fault or reproaching them. The same event may involve both.
[攻める](攻める.md) (せめる), "attack," shares the pronunciation but is a different written word.
Praising or forgiving someone can contrast contextually with blaming, without being an exact opposite in every sentence.

## Distinctive meaning

Responsibility and blame are related but not identical.
Saying that someone 責めた reports their reproach, not proof that its target was actually at fault.
The reflexive pattern 自分を責める is useful for describing self-blame without confusing it
with the passive "be blamed by someone else."

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1383160, sense 1.

# 攻撃 (こうげき) - attack; offensive

## Meaning

攻撃 is an attack or offensive. 攻撃する is a transitive verb with する: the target takes を. It can concern physical action, an attacking phase in sport, or verbal criticism.

- 後半は私たちのチームの攻撃が続きました。 (こうはんはわたしたちのチームのこうげきがつづきました。) - Our team kept attacking in the second half.
- その記事は市長の方針を攻撃しています。 (そのきじはしちょうのほうしんをこうげきしています。) - That article attacks the mayor's policy.

In the second example, the attack is criticism, not physical contact. 攻撃を受ける (こうげきをうける) means "come under attack."

## How the kanji combine

攻 contributes attacking, and 撃 contributes striking. The two action meanings reinforce each other. Their on readings are コウ + ゲキ.

## Synonyms and antonyms

守備 (しゅび), "defense," is a counterpart in sports. [批判](批判.md) (ひはん) means criticism and can describe evaluating a position without the same attacking characterization. Calling criticism 攻撃 presents it as an attack; it is not a neutral substitute in every discussion.

## Distinctive meaning

The target and setting determine the English translation. A team's 攻撃 may be its offense, while a newspaper's 攻撃 may be a verbal attack. The noun does not itself tell you whether the action was justified, successful, or physical.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1279170, senses 1-2.

# 叩く (たたく) - hit; tap; clap

## Meaning

叩く is a transitive godan verb covering striking, tapping, knocking, or beating.
The object and manner tell you the intended action: ドアを叩く, "knock on a door";
手を叩く (てをたたく), "clap one's hands"; 太鼓を叩く (たいこをたたく), "play a drum."

- 入る前に、ドアを軽く叩きました。 (はいるまえに、ドアをかるくたたきました。) - I knocked lightly on the door before entering.
- 子どもたちは歌に合わせて手を叩きました。 (こどもたちはうたにあわせててをたたきました。) - The children clapped along with the song.

The て-form is 叩いて (たたいて), the past 叩いた, and the negative 叩かない.

## How the kanji combine

叩 represents the striking action in this native verb.
The kana く is the dictionary-form ending; there is no second kanji contributing a separate word.
Both gentle tapping and stronger blows fall within the basic range.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[打つ](打つ.md) (うつ) overlaps with hitting, but each verb has its own established objects and expressions.
[触る](触る.md) (さわる), "touch," does not necessarily involve a tap or blow.
[批判](批判.md) (ひはん), "criticism," overlaps with figurative 叩く.

## Distinctive meaning

Internet or media contexts can use 叩く for attacking or harshly criticizing someone, without physical contact.
Do not translate every occurrence as violence.
Likewise, "dust" in a broad gloss can concern beating dust out of something, not every method of cleaning a surface.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1416170, senses 1 and 2.

# 切る (きる) — cut

## Meaning

切る means to cut something. It also describes ending a connection, such as hanging up a phone.

- 紙を切ります。（かみを きります。）— I cut the paper.
- 電話を切りました。（でんわを きりました。）— I hung up the phone.

The affected object takes を. This is a godan verb: 切ります きります, 切って きって, 切らない きらない.

## How the kanji combine

This is one native verb, not a compound. [切](../kanji/切.md) supplies the cutting sense and the reading き; る is okurigana, the kana ending that changes in conjugation.

## Synonyms and antonyms

- 切れる きれる describes something snapping, being cut, or running out. It often presents the event without naming someone who causes it; it is not an antonym.
- There is no one opposite for all uses. For a switch, 切る means "turn off" and 入れる いれる means "turn on."
- [着る](着る.md) きる, "put on clothing," is a different verb, not a synonym.

## Distinctive meaning

Do not conjugate 切る like 着る: "cut" is 切ります きります, while "put on" is 着ます きます. Learn nonliteral combinations such as 電話を切る as phrases rather than assuming that an object is physically cut.

For ～切る compared with ～終わる, see [the article on verb extensions](../articles/verb-extensions-direction-and-aspect.md).

# 叱る (しかる) - to scold; reprimand

## Meaning

叱る is a transitive godan verb meaning "scold" or "reprimand."
Mark the person reprimanded with を. The passive 叱られる means "be scolded";
the person doing the scolding then takes に.

- 先生は生徒を叱りました。 (せんせいはせいとをしかりました。) - The teacher scolded the student.
- 遅刻して、母に叱られました。 (ちこくして、ははにしかられました。) - I was scolded by my mother for being late.

The reason can be supplied by a preceding clause, as in the second sentence.
Useful forms are 叱って, 叱った, and 叱らない. Despite ending in る, it is not an ichidan verb.

## How the kanji combine

叱 writes the stem of the native word しかる, with る as okurigana.
The dictionary also records 𠮟る, and marks the word as usually written in kana.
Learn しかる as a complete word; the spelling variation does not create a new meaning.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[怒る](怒る.md) (おこる) can describe getting angry and can also describe scolding.
叱る specifically presents a reprimand, but this does not prove the speaker is calm or well-intentioned.
[注意](注意.md) (ちゅうい) in 注意する can be a warning or correction without the same force.

## Distinctive meaning

The contrast between scolding someone and being scolded is useful in personal narratives:
生徒を叱る versus 先生に叱られる.
The verb itself does not evaluate whether the reprimand was fair, gentle, or educational.
Those judgments need context, not a rigid distinction from 怒る.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1319580, sense 1.

# 絞る (しぼる) - wring; squeeze; narrow down

## Meaning

絞る is to wring or squeeze something, for example to remove liquid from a cloth. It is a transitive godan verb: **タオルを絞る**, "wring out a towel."

- ぬれたタオルを絞りました。
  (ぬれたタオルをしぼりました。) - I wrung out the wet towel.
- レモンを搾って、汁を加えます。
  (レモンをしぼって、しるをくわえます。) - Squeeze the lemon and add the juice.

**搾る** has the same reading. JMdict particularly associates 絞る with wringing cloth and 搾る with extracting liquid, including juice or milk. These are spelling preferences, not absolute sense restrictions; 絞る is also used for squeezing a lemon.

A useful extension is narrowing a range or focus:

- 候補を三つに絞りました。
  (こうほをみっつにしぼりました。) - We narrowed the candidates down to three.

Here を marks what is narrowed and に the resulting limit. Forms include 絞ります (しぼります), **絞って** (しぼって), and 絞らない (しぼらない).

## How the kanji combine

絞 is the single character for the native verb, with る as okurigana. Its meaning includes constricting or wringing. 搾 emphasizes squeezing out in this use. Neither spelling is a two-character compound, and neither supplies a new independent pronunciation for the verb.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[押す](押す.md) (おす) is pushing or pressing more broadly; 絞る often involves wringing, extracting, or concentrating, rather than any pressure at all. [締める](締める.md) (しめる) overlaps with tightening, such as tightening a drawstring.

[減らす](減らす.md) (へらす), "reduce," overlaps with reducing a range or amount. 候補を絞る additionally foregrounds selecting a narrower set.

## Distinctive meaning

Learn the object together with these further dictionary-recorded uses:

- 知恵を絞る (ちえをしぼる) - rack one's brains.
- 声を絞る (こえをしぼる) - strain one's voice.
- 音量を絞る (おんりょうをしぼる) - turn down the volume.
- 袋の口を絞る (ふくろのくちをしぼる) - tighten the mouth of a bag.
- レンズを絞る (レンズをしぼる) - stop down a lens.

The word can also mean scold severely or put someone through hard training. 絞られる (しぼられる) can therefore mean "get a severe scolding," not literally be wrung like a towel. These extensions do not make every use of English "press" or "train" interchangeable with 絞る. The dictionary's extortion/exploitation sense, as well as specialized bow, sumo, and go uses, is outside this practical introduction.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1594520, senses 1-3 and 5-10.
Usage: [Digital Daijisen: 絞る・搾る](https://www.weblio.jp/content/絞る).

# 恨む (うらむ) - resent; bear a grudge against

## Meaning

恨む is a transitive godan verb: resent someone or something, feel bitter
toward them, or bear a grudge. The target takes を. Useful forms are
恨みます, 恨んだ and 恨まない.

- 約束を破った友人を恨んでいました。 (やくそくをやぶったゆうじんをうらんでいました。) - I resented the friend who broke their promise.
- 私を恨まないでください。 (わたしをうらまないでください。) - Please do not hold it against me.

## How the kanji combine

恨 writes うら in the native verb 恨む; む is its dictionary-form ending.
[恨み](恨み.md) (うらみ) names the resentment or grudge.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[責める](責める.md) (せめる), "blame; reproach," can involve criticizing
someone, whereas 恨む focuses on bitter feeling toward a target.
[憎む](憎む.md) (にくむ), "hate," overlaps in hostility but does not
itself specify a grudge over a perceived wrong.
[許す](許す.md) (ゆるす), "forgive," provides a useful contrast.

## Distinctive meaning

An English translation such as "curse" need not mean casting a magical
spell: 恨む can simply express bitterness or blame. A person can 恨む
someone without telling them or taking revenge. 怨む is another
dictionary-recognized spelling of this verb.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1289780, sense 1.

# 意見 (いけん) — opinion

## Meaning

意見 is an opinion or view about a subject. Useful combinations are 意見を言う (いけんをいう), "state an opinion," and 意見を聞く (いけんをきく), "ask for/listen to an opinion."

この計画について、意見を聞かせてください。 (このけいかくについて、いけんをきかせてください。) — Please tell me your opinion about this plan.

## How the kanji combine

[意](../kanji/意.md) concerns thought or intention, and [見](../kanji/見.md) concerns seeing or a view. Together they suggest a considered view of something. Both use on-readings: い + けん.

## Synonyms and antonyms

考え (かんがえ) is broader: a thought, idea, or plan. [感想](感想.md) (かんそう) is an impression or reaction after an experience. Neither is always interchangeable with an opinion on a proposal.

## Distinctive meaning

The ordinary noun does not imply either agreement or disagreement. 私の意見 (わたしのいけん) means "my opinion." Be careful with 意見する: it can mean to admonish or remonstrate with someone, not simply the neutral act of expressing any opinion. For beginners, 意見を言う is the clearer neutral pattern.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1156530, senses 1–2.

# 努力 (どりょく) — effort

## Meaning

努力 is the effort someone puts toward a goal. The intransitive する verb 努力する means "make an effort; strive."
It can describe sustained work, not just a single attempt.

- 日本語が上手になるように努力しています。 (にほんごがじょうずになるようにどりょくしています。) — I am working hard to improve my Japanese.
- みんなの努力が実を結びました。 (みんなのどりょくがみをむすびました。) — Everyone's efforts bore fruit.

In this example, a plain verb phrase followed by ように states the result the person is aiming for.
The noun also fits 努力が必要です (どりょくがひつようです), "Effort is needed."

## How the kanji combine

[努](../kanji/努.md) means making an effort, and [力](../kanji/力.md) adds the idea of strength or exertion.
Together they name applied effort, not merely physical strength. The on readings are ド + リョク.

## Synonyms and antonyms

努める (つとめる) is a related native verb meaning "endeavor."
苦労 (くろう), "hardship; trouble," highlights difficulty experienced rather than simply the effort someone chooses to make.
A task can involve both 努力 and 苦労, but the words do not describe exactly the same aspect.

## Distinctive meaning

努力 says that someone is trying; it does not guarantee success. It also need not be physical:
practicing a language or changing a habit can involve 努力.
Avoid translating every English "try" with it when only one tentative action is intended.

# 効果 (こうか) - effect; effectiveness

## Meaning

効果 names an effect or the effectiveness of something. It is a noun: 効果がある
means "have an effect; be effective," and 効果がない means "have no effect."
The thing producing the effect can precede の.

- この薬は痛みに効果があります。 (このくすりはいたみにこうかがあります。) - This medicine is effective against pain.
- 広告の効果を調べています。 (こうこくのこうかをしらべています。) - We are investigating the advertisement's effectiveness.

In the medicine example, に marks the condition against which the medicine works.
効果的な (こうかてきな) is the related adjective "effective."

## How the kanji combine

[効](../kanji/効.md) concerns working or having efficacy; [果](../kanji/果.md) contributes a result.
Together they name the result produced by something's action. The readings are
コウ + カ, with a long first vowel.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[結果](結果.md) (けっか) is a result or outcome more generally. 効果 emphasizes
what an action, treatment, or other cause brings about, often in relation to an
intended purpose. An outcome can exist even when an attempted treatment had no
効果.

## Distinctive meaning

The noun does not establish how large or beneficial an effect is. Add a description
or context rather than assuming 効果 means complete success. It also appears in
production terms such as 音響効果 (おんきょうこうか), "sound effects": these are
created effects for a scene, not a statement that the sound is medically effective.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1275130, senses 1-2.

# 刻む (きざむ) - mince; engrave; mark a rhythm

## Meaning

刻む is a transitive godan verb: cut something finely, or carve marks into a surface. The object takes を. Its て-form is 刻んで (きざんで), and the past is 刻んだ (きざんだ).

- ねぎを細かく刻んでください。
  (ねぎをこまかくきざんでください。) - Please chop the green onion finely.
- 石に名前を刻みました。
  (いしになまえをきざみました。) - I engraved a name on the stone.

## How the kanji combine

[刻](../kanji/刻.md) concerns carving and also measured time. The native verb 刻む brings these branches together through cutting marks or marking successive moments; this is a learning association, not a historical derivation.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[切る](切る.md) (きる) is the broader "cut" verb. 刻む can specify small cuts rather than one division. 心に刻む (こころにきざむ) means to etch something into one's mind, overlapping [覚える](覚える.md) (おぼえる), "remember," without literally carving a person.

## Distinctive meaning

リズムを刻む means "beat out a rhythm"; 時計が時を刻む (とけいがときをきざむ) describes a clock marking the passing moments. For example, 小さな時計が静かに時を刻んでいました (ちいさなとけいがしずかにときをきざんでいました), "A small clock was quietly ticking away." The object and context select the sense, not a rule that 刻む always involves a knife.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1285890, senses 1-4.

# 調査 (ちょうさ) - investigation; survey

## Meaning

調査 is an investigation, inquiry, or survey carried out to obtain information.
調査する is transitive: 原因を調査する (げんいんをちょうさする), "investigate the cause."
As a noun, Xについての調査 is "an investigation/survey about X."

- 警察が事故の原因を調査しています。 (けいさつがじこのげんいんをちょうさしています。) - The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
- 学生の生活について調査を行いました。 (がくせいのせいかつについてちょうさをおこないました。) - We conducted a survey of students' lives.

調査の結果 (ちょうさのけっか) means "the results of the investigation/survey."
調査中 (ちょうさちゅう) means "under investigation" or "a survey is in progress."

## How the kanji combine

[調](../kanji/調.md) contributes examining or checking in this word, and [査](../kanji/査.md) inspection.
Their combined meaning centers on finding out facts.
The on-readings are チョウ + サ.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[調べる](調べる.md) (しらべる) is a broader everyday verb for looking into or checking something.
[研究](研究.md) (けんきゅう) is research; collecting survey information may be part of a larger research project.
[質問](質問.md) (しつもん) is a question or questioning, one possible method rather than the whole investigation.

## Distinctive meaning

調査 does not specify a questionnaire. Investigators might inspect a site, read records, interview people,
or combine methods.
Nor does 調査中 imply that the answer is already known: it identifies an ongoing inquiry rather than its conclusion.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1429120, sense 1.

# 研究 (けんきゅう) — research

## Meaning

研究 is research or a focused investigation. It is a noun and also forms the verb 研究する (けんきゅうする).
The topic being researched can take を.

- 大学で日本語を研究しています。 (だいがくでにほんごをけんきゅうしています。) — I research the Japanese language at university.
- これは私の研究です。 (これはわたしのけんきゅうです。) — This is my research.

The first example describes investigating the language as a subject, not merely taking Japanese lessons.

## How the kanji combine

[研](../kanji/研.md) contributes close study or polishing, while [究](../kanji/究.md) contributes thorough investigation.
The two related ideas reinforce each other: study a subject closely. Both readings are on readings,
ケン + キュウ → けんきゅう. Keep the long う at the end.

## Synonyms and antonyms

- [勉強](勉強.md) (べんきょう) is study or learning, such as preparing for a test; it need not involve research.
- 調べる (しらべる) means checking, looking up, or investigating. A quick lookup can be 調べる without being a research project.
- There is no single useful direct antonym of 研究. Not researching something is not a separate vocabulary item that must be memorized as its opposite.

## Distinctive meaning

研究 suggests examining a topic or problem in some depth. It is useful in academic and professional settings
but is not restricted to laboratories. For ordinary study of beginner Japanese, 日本語を勉強する
(にほんごをべんきょうする) is usually the intended expression.

研究者 (けんきゅうしゃ) adds [者](../kanji/者.md), "person," to mean "researcher."

# 弾 (たま) - bullet

## Meaning

弾 (たま) is a noun for a bullet. The spelling helps distinguish this meaning from other words pronounced たま. In descriptions, が can mark the bullet and に the place where it is found.

- 博物館には古い弾が展示されています。 (はくぶつかんにはふるいたまがてんじされています。) - Old bullets are on display in the museum.
- 壁に弾が残っていました。 (かべにたまがのこっていました。) - A bullet remained in the wall.

These examples name the object; the noun is not itself a verb meaning "shoot."

## How the kanji combine

The single character 弾 carries the bullet meaning with the native reading たま. The on reading ダン appears in compounds such as 弾丸 (だんがん), "bullet." Do not transfer that reading to this standalone noun automatically.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[玉](玉.md) and [球](球.md) also have the reading たま. 玉 is used for such things as balls or gems, while 球 is useful for balls and spheres. These spellings share a dictionary entry, but that does not make them good substitutes in every context.

## Distinctive meaning

JMdict specifically associates the bullet sense with 弾 as a spelling preference. Learn that practical association rather than treating the entire entry's ball, jewel, and other senses as the definition of this card. There is no useful direct antonym.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1240530, sense 5.

# 不正 (ふせい) - wrongdoing; dishonesty

## Meaning

不正 names wrongdoing, dishonesty, unfairness, or an improper irregularity.
It also modifies nouns with な or in established compounds:
不正な行為 (ふせいなこうい), "improper conduct."

- 試験で不正をしてはいけません。 (しけんでふせいをしてはいけません。) - You must not cheat on the examination.
- 会社は不正な取引を調査しています。 (かいしゃはふせいなとりひきをちょうさしています。) - The company is investigating improper transactions.

不正をする means engaging in wrongdoing or cheating. 不正に can describe an
action performed improperly or fraudulently.

## How the kanji combine

[不](../kanji/不.md) negates what follows, and [正](../kanji/正.md) contributes
rightness or correctness. Together they describe what is not proper or right.
The readings are フ + セイ.

## Synonyms and antonyms

違法 (いほう) explicitly concerns being against the law.
不正 may concern rules or integrity without itself establishing a legal offense.
[正しい](正しい.md) (ただしい), "correct; right," provides a contextual contrast.
[間違い](間違い.md) (まちがい), "mistake," does not by itself accuse someone of
dishonesty.

## Distinctive meaning

In the examination example, 不正 suggests cheating, not merely giving a wrong
answer. In technical contexts it can describe invalid or improper data without
implying malicious intent. The object and setting determine whether the issue
is fraud, fairness, rule-breaking, or a technical irregularity; do not infer a
person's intention from the word alone.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1493370, sense 1.
